content.objective: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀವು ಕಲಿಯುವುದು: ಭೂತಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಭೂತ ನಿರಂತರ ಕಾಲ ಬಳಸುವುದು.
content.explanation: Use past continuous for actions that were happening at a specific time in the past. Form: was/were + verb-ing.
examples: I was reading a book when he called.
She was working in the office at 5 PM.

content.objective: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀವು ಕಲಿಯುವುದು: ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಭೂತ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಂಡ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಭೂತ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಾಲ ಬಳಸುವುದು.
content.explanation: Use past perfect for actions completed before another past action. Form: had + past participle.
examples: I had finished my work before he arrived.

He had never been to India before that trip.
We had already eaten when they called.
I had read the book before watching the movie.

speakingPractice.english: I will have finished my work by tomorrow and she will have lived in Bangalore for 10 years.
speakingPractice.kannada: ನಾನು ನಾಳೆಯೊಳಗೆ ನನ್ನ ಕೆಲಸ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವಳು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ 10 ವರ್ಷ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿರುತ್ತಾಳೆ.

content.objective: ಈ ಪಾಠದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀವು ಕಲಿಯುವುದು: ಭವಿಷ್ಯತ್ತಿನ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಸಮಯದವರೆಗೆ ಮುಂದುವರೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ಪೂರ್ಣ ನಿರಂತರ ಕಾಲ ಬಳಸುವುದು.
content.explanation: Use future perfect continuous for actions that will have been continuing until a specific time in the future. Form: will have been + verb-ing.
examples: I will have been working here for 10 years by next year.
She will have been living in Bangalore for 15 years by 2030.
They will have been playing football for 2 hours by 5 PM.
He will have been sleeping for 8 hours by morning.
We will have been studying English for 1 year by next month.
I will have been reading the book for 2 weeks by next Friday.
She will have been teaching for 20 years by retirement.
They will have been building the house for 1 year by completion.
He will have been writing the novel for 3 years by publication.
It will have been raining for 24 hours by tomorrow morning.
